title: Smooth, Oddly-Shaped Blade Doesn't Scratch Cookware, But Doesn't Cut Baked Goods Easily
text:
Smooth, Oddly-Shaped Blade Doesn't Scratch Cookware, But Doesn't Cut Baked Goods Easily. The NORPRO "MY FAVORITE KNIFE" does not scratch nonstick bakeware, even if you use extra pressure in drawing it across the bakeware surface. However, because the short, oddly-shaped blade lacks a serrated edge, this knife doesn't cut cornbread or brownies nearly as easily as the elegant 12" [[ASIN:B005B8M2WU Zyliss Dessert Knife (nonstick surface-safe)]], or the stubby 8" [[ASIN:B0000CF8HR Bakeware Buddy Non-Stick Surface-Safe Plastic Knife]].

From handle tip to blade tip, the Norpro "My Favorite Knife" is 9 inches long; the knife is balanced and the handle is comfortable to hold. My knife is green, and matches the green shown in the product page photo. As an add-on item priced at about $3, this is a pretty good deal. But because of the smooth-edged blade, I rate this Teflon-safe knife at just 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).
